title: Dont wake the 99 night DUPE AUTO STEAL AUTO LOCK INSTA STEAL

game.name: Don't Wake the 99 Nights in the Forest!

script:
getgenv().Settings = {
    stealThreshold = 475,  -- minimum amount the character must generate every second, any character below value this will be ignored (unless its something you searched for) 
    autoLock = true,
    instantProximityPrompts = true,
    speedboost = 23,
	jumpboost = 12,
}

loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raxscripts/LuaUscripts/refs/heads/main/DontWake99Nights.lua"))()
features:
supports ALL executors

NOTE: duping only works on non-player owned characters, so if you are stealing from a player, the dupe will not work, however if you steal from the area where they spawn, they will be duped.

AFTER duping the item you can place one of the items, upgrade it (to level 30 for example) and then pick it back up, and you will have duped level 30 characters (search your inventory for them if needed)

Features:
• INSTA STEAL BEST CHARACTER
• AUTO LOCK BASE
• DUPE STOLEN CHARACTERS
• AUTO STEAL FROM PEOPLES BASE AND SPAWN AREA
• ANTI HIT
• SPEED BOOST
